hypotheses.name: conditional_physical_realization
hypotheses.statement: At least one evidence-supported deployment and supply pathway can satisfy the admitted Terafab target interpretation and every required manufacturing, facility, temporal, and electricity-security gate by 2050.
hypotheses.null_statement: No evidence-supported pathway satisfies all required gates by 2050.

evaluation.support_rule: Supported when at least one pathway has a dimensionally valid target interpretation and passes all required gates using evidence-supported parameter ranges.
evaluation.falsification_rule: Falsified when every admitted pathway fails at least one required gate through 2050.
evaluation.indeterminate_rule: Indeterminate when target semantics or indispensable public evidence cannot be bounded defensibly.

hypotheses.name: regional_constraint_visibility
hypotheses.statement: At least one Terafab pathway that remains inside the spread of admitted national annual-electricity projections nevertheless violates an ERCOT firm-capacity or probabilistic adequacy constraint.
hypotheses.null_statement: No pathway inside the admitted national annual-electricity projection spread violates an ERCOT adequacy constraint.

evaluation.support_rule: Supported when at least one pathway remains within the admitted EIA national annual-electricity case spread while an official ERCOT adequacy gate fails for that same pathway and year.
evaluation.falsification_rule: Falsified when no pathway meeting the national-case-spread condition violates an ERCOT adequacy gate.
evaluation.indeterminate_rule: Indeterminate when comparable regional and national constraint margins cannot be constructed from authoritative baselines.

hypotheses.name: supply_portfolio_effect
hypotheses.statement: A pre-committed firm or hybrid electricity-supply portfolio reduces incremental ERCOT adequacy risk relative to a grid-dominant connection at the same manufacturing trajectory.
hypotheses.null_statement: A firm or hybrid portfolio does not reduce incremental ERCOT adequacy risk relative to the grid-dominant case.

evaluation.support_rule: Supported when adequacy risk is lower under the firm or hybrid portfolio using identical manufacturing demand and consistently modeled outages, fuel, and accredited capacity.
evaluation.falsification_rule: Falsified when no admitted firm or hybrid portfolio lowers the primary adequacy-risk metric.
evaluation.indeterminate_rule: Indeterminate when hourly adequacy or accredited-capacity evidence is unavailable.

hypotheses.name: scale_uncertainty_concentration
hypotheses.statement: The leading 20% of admitted uncertain inputs account for at least 80% of normalized total-order sensitivity mass for target realization year or joint feasibility, with stable bootstrap ranks.
hypotheses.null_statement: The leading 20% of admitted uncertain inputs account for less than 80% of normalized total-order sensitivity mass or their ranks are unstable.

evaluation.support_rule: Supported when the top ceiling(0.20 times N) inputs account for at least 0.80 of normalized total-order sensitivity mass for either primary outcome and bootstrap rank stability meets the Step 2 confidence rule.
evaluation.falsification_rule: Falsified when the predeclared 20/80 concentration condition is not met or rankings fail the bootstrap stability rule.
evaluation.indeterminate_rule: Indeterminate when the evidence does not support probability distributions or dependence structures.

locking_rule: Hypothesis wording and evaluation rules cannot be changed after scenario results are inspected. Evidence-driven retirement is allowed only during Step 2 and must remain documented.
